storage_inventory.grant_state: Existing R3 opaque-reference hash, original binding/snapshot/lifetime and current active/revoked decision; never raw grant_reference.

rotation_retention.purge: Controlled removal of only minimal rotation evidence after its fixed deadline; never reset the source expiry, keep raw credentials, purge an independent audit, or grant authority when evidence is absent.

field_inventory.scope: all listed internal fields, never request DTO

wire.base: Explicit effective organization permissions and current R3 authority; no OWNER/H2/header inference.
wire.access: Private authenticated gateway workload, live person/session/membership/scope and approved device, fresh MFA and current backend decision.
wire.encryption: TLS and identity operational at-rest protection.
wire.export_correction: Authorized identity export, new audited facts; never rewrite grants, issuance or rotation evidence.
wire.purpose: Explicit exceptional grant renewal and bound response; opaque reference is a one-purpose bearer, not a password/JWT.
wire.retention: Existing R3 lifecycle and no-store caller handling; no authorization cache, logs or persistent raw grant references.

rotation.base: Explicit effective organization permissions and current R3 authority; no OWNER/H2/header inference.
rotation.access: Private authenticated gateway workload, live person/session/membership/scope and approved device, fresh MFA and current backend decision.
rotation.encryption: TLS and identity operational at-rest protection.
rotation.export_correction: Authorized identity export, new audited facts; never rewrite grants, issuance or rotation evidence.
rotation.purpose: Prove one direct completeSessionStepUp credential transition for one associated original grant, without retaining credentials or factors.
rotation.retention: Exactly 24 hours after associated source grant original expiry, no extension on renewal/read; independent immutable audit retains its own ADR-016/035 policy.

error.base: Explicit effective organization permissions and current R3 authority; no OWNER/H2/header inference.
error.access: Private authenticated gateway workload, live person/session/membership/scope and approved device, fresh MFA and current backend decision.
error.encryption: TLS and identity operational at-rest protection.
error.export_correction: Authorized identity export, new audited facts; never rewrite grants, issuance or rotation evidence.
error.purpose: Uniform canonical R3 rejection without protected details.
error.retention: Response only, no values in logs or authority caches.
